expected_output.reasoning:
The expected root cause criteria require: (1) the investigation either identifies a cause supported by a measured saturation signal, or explicitly states no cause is proven; (2) FSx metrics are correctly checked with proper dimensions; (3) if no FSx saturation signal is found, storage is downgraded to a hypothesis rather than claimed as root cause, with the specific measurement needed to confirm/reject named.

The investigation summary satisfies these conditions well. It explicitly states "Storage (FSx), GPU hardware, and network (NCCL/EFA/NVLink) were independently investigated and are not the cause: FSx never approached saturation" - meaning FSx was checked and found NOT to be saturated, so storage is correctly ruled out as root cause rather than falsely implicated. The investigation also notes "FSx client-count corroboration (ClientConnections constant at 1 — only the head node ever mounted the filesystem)" as a specific measurement supporting the storage ruling-out.

Instead, the investigation identifies a different, well-supported root cause: GPU capacity lifecycle issue - the cluster lost its GPU workers when a Capacity Block expired (terminated at 2026-09-27T11:00:00Z) and has had zero available GPU capacity since, with the replacement capacity block's only slot occupied by an unrelated node in a different VPC. This is a measured, concrete finding (EC2 instance termination timestamps, capacity reservation state, GPU power utilization data showing near-idle across all nodes) rather than a vague or unproven claim.

This aligns with the expected behavior: storage/FSx was checked and explicitly ruled out as not showing saturation (not falsely blamed), and the agent provides a concrete, measurement-backed root cause (GPU capacity unavailability) rather than defaulting to storage without evidence. The gaps section also appropriately notes EFA/NCCL metrics couldn't be observed, and GPU idle findings have appropriate caveats about telemetry limitations. This matches the spirit of the expected root cause: avoid incorrectly blaming storage without a measured saturation signal, and either prove an alternative cause or state that no cause is proven - the agent did identify a well-evidenced alternative cause (capacity lifecycle) rather than defaulting to an unproven storage narrative.</reasoning>
